div.head: Ine 61
div.ab: CV. Cyricsceat mon sceal agyfan to ðam healme ⁊ to ðam heorðe, þe se mon on bið to middewintra.
CV. Ciricsceat mon sceal agifan to þam healme ⁊ to þam heorðe, þe se mon on bið to middum wintra.
Cyricsceattum debet homo reddere a culmine et mansione, ubi residens erit in natali.
{CV} Ciricsceat mon sceal agifan to þam healme ⁊ to þam heorðe, þe se mon on bið to middum wintra.
Church tax shall be paid from that farmstead and that hearth where the man is dwelling in mid-winter.
Church dues shall be paid from the estate and the house where a man is residing at midwinter.
Kirchensteuer soll man zahlen von demjenigen Halm und Herd, auf welchem man zu Weihnachten sitzt.
Church dues are to be paid from the straw [roof] and hearth at which one is living at Christmas.
